import re

def parse_nginx_access_log(line: str) -> dict:
    """
    Parse a single nginx access log line (combined log format) into a dictionary.
    
    Expected format:
    IP - - [timestamp] "METHOD /path HTTP/version" status bytes "referer" "user-agent"
    
    Example:
    192.168.1.1 - - [10/Oct/2023:13:55:36 +0000] "GET /index.html HTTP/1.1" 200 2326 "-" "Mozilla/5.0"
    """
    # Regex pattern for nginx combined log format
    pattern = (
        r'^(?P<ip>\S+)\s+'          # IP address
        r'(?P<ident>\S+)\s+'        # ident (usually -)
        r'(?P<user>\S+)\s+'         # user (usually -)
        r'\[(?P<timestamp>[^\]]+)\]\s+'  # timestamp in brackets
        r'"(?P<method>\S+)\s+(?P<path>\S+)\s+(?P<protocol>[^"]+)"\s+'  # request line
        r'(?P<status>\d{3})\s+'     # status code
        r'(?P<bytes>\d+|-)\s+'      # response size in bytes (or -)
        r'"(?P<referer>[^"]*)"\s+'  # referer
        r'"(?P<user_agent>[^"]*)"'  # user agent
    )
    
    match = re.match(pattern, line)
    if not match:
        raise ValueError(f"Log line does not match expected nginx access log format: {line}")
